meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Store a dag definition once and re-run it in one or two lines, instead of pasting the full definition JSON into every eval cell. MUST USE whenever the user wants to save a DAG for reuse, run a previously saved/named DAG, schedule the same graph repeatedly (nightly/weekly audits, recurring multi-agent pipelines), or asks where to put a dag definition file. Triggers: dag library, save this dag, reuse a dag, run the saved dag, stored dag definition, recurring dag, nightly dag, dag 정의 저장, 저장된 dag 실행, dag 반복 실행, DAG 만들어두고 여러 번.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存常用流程一次，以后按名一键重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有反复要跑的流程，想存一次就能复用。
copy.tagline_en: Save a workflow once, then rerun it anytime by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have workflows you run repeatedly and want to store them once.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以把一个 DAG 的定义保存为文件,之后用一两行代码按名字重新运行,不用再粘贴完整定义。运行时默认会自动加时间戳,让每次运行都是新的。
howto.when: 当你想保存 DAG 以便复用、运行已保存的 DAG,或需要重复执行同一张图(如每日/每周审计)时触发。提到“保存 DAG”“运行已保存的 DAG”等关键词也会触发。

say.text: 把这个 DAG 保存成 nightly-audit
say.note: 会写入库目录,并立即运行一次确认。

say.text: 运行我之前保存的 nightly-audit
say.note: 默认加时间戳,启动全新的一次运行。
若该后缀已有运行,会复用而不是新跑。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can save a DAG definition to a file and re-run it by name with one or two lines of code, instead of pasting the full definition JSON. By default, each run gets a timestamp suffix so it always starts fresh.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to save a DAG for reuse, run a previously saved/named DAG, or run the same graph repeatedly (e.g., nightly/weekly audits). Keywords like 'save DAG', 'run saved DAG' also trigger it.

say_en.note: It will be written to the library dir and run once to confirm.
A fresh run starts with a new timestamp.
Reuses the existing run for that suffix if present.
